values.meaning: True Damage missing-health ratio by rank

mechanics.claim: The ability is unit-targeted with a cast time before the damage is dealt, during which Garen reveals the target.
mechanics.quote: dealing them {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}} as well as {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for 1 second at the start of the cast time

mechanics.claim: The damage is true damage, ignoring resistances entirely.
The missing-health scaling means the true damage effectively increases as the target's health drops, favoring later hits in a prolonged fight.
The ability can be blocked by spell shields.
If Garen dies during the cast time, the ability visually shows as on cooldown and cannot be recast until the cooldown elapses (a known bug), though clicking the ability icon fixes this.
mechanics.quote: If '''Garen''' dies during ''Demacian Justice's'' cast time, it will visually appear as on cooldown and he won't be able to cast it until the cooldown has elapsed.
